Shout.effect: cure any allies who are confused or sleeping. Heal any pokemon that had a status removed for 1/4 their max hp

Sirens Blessing.effect: If this pokemons attack makes a bonus check against its target, replace it with a 30% chance to make drowsy and a 30% chance to confuse for 2 turns

Soft Light.effect: heals all allies for 70 and removes status conditions

Strategist.effect: all allies gain +1 speed and +1 crit chance for 3 turns

Stroke Of Genius.effect: Recover one of your previously held items (replace current item if holding one)

Tactical Retreat.effect: restore 40 hp to all allies and give them +1 range. Allies with no enemies within 2 tiles (ignoring all terrain) restore 80 hp but do not receive the range bonus

Temperate.effect: heal all allies who are burned or frozen. Heal any pokemon that had a status removed for 1/4 their max hp

The Pharoah's Curse.effect: Replace this pokemons ability with mummy for 2 turns (you choose contact or non contact)

Trickster.effect: increase speed 2 stages, allow pokemon to jump enemies and high ledges, and increase crit chance for 3 turns

Type X.effect: choose "type x skill" and then choose which to use at the start of the game

Unrivaled.effect: increase attack, speed, and defense 1 stage for 4 turns

Vipers Bite.effect: attack gains extra effect "inflict random status condition" for 3 turns

Vipers Blessing.effect: If this pokemons attack makes a bonus check against its target, replace it with a 30% chance to poison and a 30% chance to paralyze for 2 turns

Warrior Woman.effect: gain +1 speed and 100% flinch chance for 1 turn

Willpower.effect: increases crit chance 2 stages and attack 1 stage for 1 turn
